description: The line plot illustrates the loss ratio (%) across different TFLOPs (tera floating-point operations) for four models: Vanilla, SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=128), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T). The x-axis, labeled "TFLOPs," is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick marks at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 7e8, and 9e8. The y-axis, labeled "Loss Ratio (%)," is on a linear scale from 94 to 100. The Vanilla model (purple line with triangles) maintains a loss ratio of 100% across all TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=64) model (orange line with circles) starts at 98% and increases to 100% at 4e8 TFLOPs, then slightly decreases. The SepLLM (n=128) model (blue line with stars) starts at 97% and increases to 100% at 2e8 TFLOPs, then slightly decreases. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) model (green line with diamonds) starts at 97% and increases to 100% at 2e8 TFLOPs, then slightly decreases.
